title: Steffi for Men – US Launch
description: Help make Steffi for Men known across the US. Turn our supplied fragrance videos into engaging English TikTok clips and post them on your own account. Reach US audiences, showcase the brand and fragrances, and encourage viewers to discover our official channels. Earn based on approved views.
guidelines:
Create engaging clips using the supplied Steffi for Men videos.
Use English and create content for a US audience.
Start with a strong hook in the first 1–2 seconds.
Make the Steffi for Men brand name clearly visible and easy to remember.
Focus on the fragrances and building brand awareness.
Publish each clip on your own public TikTok account.
Include “Steffi for Men” in the caption.
Create your own edit rather than reposting the original video unchanged.
Do not invent personal experiences or product claims.
Clearly disclose the paid collaboration in every post.
Only organic views are eligible. No bots, purchased views or paid boosts.
